How it works

From idea to visualization
in three steps.

No subscriptions. No learning curve. No magic — just clear prompts that any AI tool can turn into a beautiful visual.

01

Pick your visualization

Choose from 13 categories and 60+ chart types — from mindmaps to SWOT analyses, every visual format Napkin AI offers.

02

Choose your style

Select a color palette from 25 curated combinations, then pick connector style, icon style, and layout mood.

03

Copy your prompt

Get a detailed, AI-ready prompt. Paste it into Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, or Midjourney and get your visualization.
